evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Develop and maintain high quality data warehouse solution
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Quality/maintenance language ("high quality", "scalable and maintainable") is balanced against generic "high performance" and "agile team" framing with no strong velocity or rigour signal dominating.
evidence.domain_risk: development, enhancement, and maintenance of our Data Engagement Platform (DEP)... development of BI solutions and reports
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: This is internal BI/reporting infrastructure for a dental products manufacturer with no financial, regulatory, or safety-critical framing despite being a healthcare-adjacent company — the role itself is generic BI/data engineering.
evidence.collaboration_width: finance; marketing; sales; commercial; supply and operations
evidence.data_team_maturity: Our Global Data and Analytics department... The team consists of 20+ members and work cross-functionally
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An explicit team size of 20+ members with named tooling already deployed (Azure, Databricks, dbt) and an established platform (DEP) indicates a mature, specialised data function.
evidence.jd_authorship: We use Azure tools together with Databricks and dbt... Perform maintenance and troubleshooting activities in Azure data platform
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Named tools and concrete tasks (Azure DevOps, Databricks, dbt, data warehouse maintenance) give a fairly clear picture of daily work, though mixed with some generic phrases ("additional responsibilities as assigned", "bringing out the best in people").
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Collaborate with BI Developers and Business Analysts for successful development of BI reporting and analysis
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's primary audience is the internal data/BI function itself (BI Developers, Business Analysts, Global Data and Analytics team), even though the platform ultimately serves finance/marketing/sales/etc.
evidence.autonomy_level: Work in a small, smart, agile team – design, develop and own full solution for an assigned data area
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Despite "own full solution for an assigned data area," the role's overall framing is executing maintenance, troubleshooting, and development work within an existing established platform rather than setting direction.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI tools, AI-assisted coding, or AI-consuming data infrastructure anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality framework language present.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: The JD mentions "high quality data warehouse solution" and troubleshooting but never names a testing practice, data contract, or quality framework.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed in delivery/maintenance/collaboration terms with no risk register, incident, or compliance-driven fear language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: development, enhancement, and maintenance of our Data Engagement Platform (DEP)
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role explicitly works on an existing, established platform (DEP) doing enhancement and maintenance rather than building from zero.
evidence.language_gate: English language – proficiency in verbal and written communication
